description: Create a complete e-commerce platform for BoosterTea - Ukrainian premium tea concentrates brand. DESIGN: Dark theme (#0D0D0D background), lime-green accent (#9FD356), warm brown (#8B7355), cream text (#F5F0E8). Typography: Cormorant Garamond for headings, Manrope for body. Ukrainian language throughout. STRUCTURE: Create a multi-page Next.js app with these routes: 1) HOME PAGE (/): Hero section with animated 15-second timer concept, video background placeholder, headline 'Готовий напій за 15 секунд', 3 product cards preview, 'How it works' 4-step section, usage scenarios (morning energy, evening calm, student focus, driver alertness), testimonials placeholder, Instagram feed placeholder, footer with all contacts. 2) PRODUCTS PAGE (/products): Catalog with filters by type and volume, product cards with hover effects. 3) INDIVIDUAL PRODUCT PAGES (/products/[slug]): For pu-erh, da-hong-pao, gaba - each with image gallery, volume selector (1L, 0.5L coming soon, 0.25L), dynamic price calculator, detailed description, effects, brewing instructions, 'Try also' recommendations, reviews. 4) B2B PAGE (/b2b): Benefits for business, interactive profit calculator (inputs: cups per day, selling price; outputs: monthly profit, ROI), Ukraine map with partner locations placeholder, case studies, CTA to Telegram @booster_tea_b2b. 5) BLOG PAGE (/blog): Grid of articles about Chinese tea. 6) CART (/cart): Cart items, promo code input, bonus points display, witty microcopy messages. 7) USER ACCOUNT (/account): Profile, orders with status tracking, bonus points, fun tea facts. 8) CONTACTS (/contacts). 9) ADMIN DASHBOARD (/admin): Sidebar navigation with Dashboard, Orders, Customers, Products, Promo Codes, Promotions/Discounts calculator, Bonuses, Settings. Include charts placeholders. FEATURES: Sticky header with cart icon and item count, smooth scroll, mobile hamburger menu, floating Telegram button, witty Ukrainian microcopy for all interactions (add to cart: 'Чудово! Твій чай вже чекає', empty cart: 'Тут поки порожньо. Як чашка без чаю — сумно', etc.). PRICING: PU-ERH 1L=975₴, DA HONG PAO 1L=1020₴, GABA 1L=1200₴. 0.25L = -30% discount. Min order: 6pcs for 1L, 12pcs for 0.25L. CONTACTS: Phone +380 96 310 96 22, Address: Львів, вул. Богдана Хмельницького 66а, Email: office@boostertea.com.ua, Social: TikTok @booster_tea, Instagram @booster_tea_ua, Telegram channels as specified.

Enhance the admin panel with complete customer database management. Add /admin/customers page with: 1) Customer list table showing ID, name, email, phone, total orders, total spent, bonus points, registration date, last order date. 2) Search and filter by name/email/phone. 3) Sort by any column. 4) Customer detail modal/page showing full profile, order history, bonus transactions, notes. 5) Ability to manually add bonus points with reason. 6) Export customers to CSV button. 7) Customer segments/tags (VIP, New, Inactive). Also enhance /admin/bonuses page with: bonus rules configuration (signup bonus, referral bonus, birthday multiplier, points per hryvnia spent), bonus transactions log, manual bonus adjustment for specific customer. Add /admin/promos page enhancements: create/edit/delete promo codes, set discount type (percentage, fixed, free shipping, free product), usage limits, expiration dates, minimum order amount, track usage statistics.

Enhance user account area (/account) with: 1) Beautiful order tracking with timeline visualization showing: 'Оформлено' -> 'Обробляється' -> 'Відправлено' -> 'Доставлено', each step with date/time, tracking number when shipped. 2) Fun facts section about user's tea journey: 'You've drunk equivalent of X cups', 'That's Y liters of tea', 'You've saved Z minutes vs traditional brewing', 'Your favorite tea is...', 'You've been with us for N days'. 3) Referral program section with unique referral code, share buttons for social/copy link, list of referred friends and their status. 4) Promo code input field to save favorite codes. 5) Address book for saved delivery addresses. 6) Notification preferences (email, SMS, Telegram). Also add authentication flow: /login and /register pages with proper forms, password requirements, email verification placeholder, social login buttons placeholder (Google, Apple). Make the account area protected - show login prompt if not authenticated (use localStorage to simulate auth state).

Add WOW effects and premium animations throughout the site: 1) On homepage hero: Add a large animated '15' with seconds counting down animation that loops, steam/vapor particles rising effect, subtle parallax on scroll. 2) Product cards: On hover show a gentle rotation/3D tilt effect, add a shimmer/shine sweep animation. 3) Add to cart: Show a smooth flying animation of product to cart icon, cart icon bounces when item added, toast notification slides in from bottom-right with tea cup icon. 4) Checkout success: Confetti animation with tea leaves falling. 5) Loading states: Custom tea cup filling animation instead of spinner. 6) Page transitions: Smooth fade transitions between pages. 7) Scroll animations: Elements fade/slide in as user scrolls down (intersection observer). 8) On product detail page: Show a beautiful brewing guide with animated steps - water heating, tea concentration being added, steam rising from cup. 9) B2B profit calculator: Animated counter for numbers, chart that draws itself in. 10) 404 page: Creative tea-themed 404 with spilled tea cup animation and witty Ukrainian message.

Create an 'Adaptation' page (/adaptation) that explains how businesses can implement BoosterTea. Structure: 1) Hero: 'Повний гайд з адаптації BoosterTea у ваш бізнес'. 2) Step-by-step implementation guide with 6 steps: (Крок 1: Замовлення - choose products, min order; Крок 2: Отримання - delivery info; Крок 3: Навчання персоналу - 5-minute training, video placeholder; Крок 4: Інтеграція в меню - pricing suggestions, menu design tips; Крок 5: Маркетингова підтримка - POS materials, social media templates; Крок 6: Зворотний зв'язок - support channels). 3) FAQ section for business partners. 4) Downloadable resources section (menu templates, training video, POS designs). 5) Success metrics section (average profit increase, customer satisfaction). 6) Contact form specifically for adaptation inquiries. Also add navigation link to this page from the B2B page and footer. Style consistently with the rest of the site.

PHASE 1A - Database Schema & API: Create a complete database schema in src/api/database/schema.ts using Drizzle ORM with these tables: 1) products (id, slug, name_uk, name_en, name_es, description_uk, description_en, description_es, category, price_1l, price_025l, image, effects_uk, effects_en, effects_es, brewing_time, temperature, origin, is_active, created_at, updated_at). Categories: 'concentrate', 'accessory', 'dry_tea'. 2) orders (id, order_number, user_id, status, total, discount, promo_code, delivery_method, delivery_address, delivery_city, delivery_warehouse, nova_poshta_ttn, payment_status, payment_id, notes, created_at, updated_at). Statuses: pending, processing, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled. 3) order_items (id, order_id, product_id, volume, quantity, price). 4) users (id, email, phone, name, password_hash, bonus_points, referral_code, referred_by, is_admin, created_at). 5) promo_codes (id, code, discount_type, discount_value, min_order, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, is_active). 6) bonus_transactions (id, user_id, amount, type, reason, created_at). 7) reviews (id, product_id, user_id, rating, text, is_approved, created_at). Create API endpoints in src/api/index.ts for: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE products, GET/POST orders, GET/POST users, validate promo codes, manage bonuses.

PHASE 1B - Internationalization (i18n): Implement full multilingual support for Ukrainian (default), English, and Spanish. 1) Create src/web/lib/i18n.tsx with: LanguageContext, useLanguage hook, t() translation function, language switcher component. 2) Create src/web/locales/uk.json, en.json, es.json with ALL text strings: navigation (home, products, b2b, blog, cart, account, contacts, admin), product info, checkout, footer, error messages, toast messages, witty microcopy in each language. 3) Update Header.tsx to include language switcher (dropdown with flags: 🇺🇦 UA, 🇬🇧 EN, 🇪🇸 ES). 4) Store language preference in localStorage. 5) Update ALL pages and components to use t() function instead of hardcoded Ukrainian text. 6) Ensure SEO: add lang attribute to html, proper hreflang meta tags. Make sure witty messages are also translated: empty cart message, add to cart confirmation, error messages, 404 page text.

PHASE 1C - SEO Optimization & AI Search: Create comprehensive SEO infrastructure. 1) Create src/web/components/SEO.tsx component that adds: dynamic title, meta description, Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type), Twitter cards, canonical URL, JSON-LD structured data. 2) Add Schema.org markup for: Organization (BoosterTea brand info), Product (each product page), LocalBusiness (Lviv location), BreadcrumbList, FAQPage (for B2B page), WebSite with SearchAction. 3) Create public/robots.txt with proper rules. 4) Create public/sitemap.xml with all pages. 5) Create public/llms.txt file for AI search bots (new 2025 standard) with site description and key info. 6) Add SEO component to ALL pages with unique titles and descriptions. 7) Ensure all images have alt text. 8) Add proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3). Product pages should have rich snippets with price, availability, reviews schema.

PHASE 2A - Monobank Checkout Integration: 1) Create src/web/lib/monobank.ts with functions: createInvoice(amount, orderId, redirectUrl, webhookUrl), getInvoiceStatus(invoiceId), verifyWebhookSignature(signature, body, pubKey). 2) Create src/api/routes/payment.ts with endpoints: POST /api/payment/create-invoice (creates Monobank invoice, saves payment_id to order), POST /api/payment/webhook (receives Monobank status updates, updates order payment_status), GET /api/payment/status/:invoiceId. 3) Create src/web/pages/checkout.tsx - complete checkout flow: Step 1 - Contact info (name, phone, email), Step 2 - Delivery (Nova Poshta placeholder for now), Step 3 - Payment summary with 'Pay with Monobank' button. Show order total, applied discounts, bonus points used. 4) After successful payment redirect to /order-success page with order details and tracking info. 5) Add checkout route to app.tsx. 6) Update cart page with 'Proceed to checkout' button that goes to /checkout. Store requires MONOBANK_TOKEN env variable (show placeholder notice if not set).

PHASE 2B - Nova Poshta Integration: 1) Create src/web/lib/novaposhta.ts with Nova Poshta API functions: searchCities(query) - search settlements, getWarehouses(cityRef) - get warehouses in city, createTTN(orderData) - create shipping document (placeholder), trackPackage(ttn) - track shipment status. API endpoint: https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/ 2) Create src/web/components/NovaPoshtaSelector.tsx - a smart city/warehouse selector component with: autocomplete city search (debounced), warehouse dropdown that loads after city selected, show warehouse type (branch, postomat, cargo), loading states, error handling. 3) Update checkout.tsx Step 2 to use NovaPoshtaSelector when 'Nova Poshta' delivery is selected. 4) Store selected city name, warehouse number, and ref in order. 5) Add API endpoints POST /api/novaposhta/cities, POST /api/novaposhta/warehouses for proxy calls (to avoid CORS). Requires NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY env variable.

PHASE 3A - Accessories Category & Dynamic Product Management: 1) Create /accessories page (src/web/pages/accessories.tsx) - grid of tea accessories: thermoses, thermal mugs, cups, pialas (tea bowls), teapots, and dry tea category. Show product cards with images, names, prices. Filters: category (thermoses, mugs, cups, dry-tea), price range. 2) Update admin products page (/admin with products tab) to be a FULL CMS: - List all products from database (use API) - Add new product form with: name (UK/EN/ES), description (UK/EN/ES), category dropdown (concentrate, accessory, dry_tea), subcategory, prices, image upload, effects (for concentrates), is_active toggle. - Edit existing products - Delete with confirmation - Image preview - Real-time validation. 3) Update products catalog to fetch from API instead of hardcoded array. 4) Add accessories link to navigation. 5) Create sample accessory products in the store: Термос BoosterTea 500ml (899 UAH), Термокружка Travel (549 UAH), Чашка Ceramic (299 UAH), Піала Gongfu (199 UAH), Сухий чай Пуер 100г (450 UAH).

PHASE 3B - Dark/Light Mode: 1) Create src/web/lib/theme.tsx with: ThemeContext, ThemeProvider, useTheme hook, theme values ('dark', 'light', 'system'). Store preference in localStorage. Listen to system preference changes. 2) Create src/web/components/ThemeToggle.tsx - a beautiful toggle button with sun/moon icons and smooth animation between modes. 3) Update all CSS to use CSS variables for colors: --bg-primary, --bg-secondary, --text-primary, --text-muted, --accent, --accent-hover, --border, --card-bg. Define light mode values (white/cream backgrounds, dark text). 4) Update Header to include ThemeToggle button next to language switcher. 5) Add theme transitions (smooth color changes). 6) Ensure ALL pages look good in both modes: check contrast ratios, card backgrounds, input fields, modals. Light mode should feel warm and premium (cream/beige tones, brown accents), not clinical white.

PHASE 4 - Notifications System: 1) Create src/web/lib/notifications.ts with: Telegram bot notification function (send message to chat_id using bot token), email notification placeholder structure. 2) Create admin notification settings page/tab: configure Telegram bot token, chat ID for order notifications, enable/disable notification types (new order, payment received, order shipped). 3) Update order creation API to send Telegram notification with order details: order number, customer name, phone, total, products list. Format message nicely with emojis. 4) Add browser push notification support: request permission on first visit, save subscription, send notification when order status changes. 5) Create /api/notifications/telegram endpoint for sending messages. 6) In admin dashboard, add a 'Test notification' button to verify Telegram setup works. Message format example: '📦 Нове замовлення #BT-001
👤 Іван Петренко
📱 +380...
💰 1950₴
🍵 Pu-erh 1L x2'

CRITICAL MOBILE FIX: Completely overhaul mobile responsiveness. 1) Ensure ALL pages work perfectly on screens 320px-428px. 2) Fix any text overflow issues - use text-ellipsis, break-words where needed. 3) Make all tables horizontally scrollable on mobile with proper touch scrolling. 4) Ensure modals are max-height 90vh with internal scroll. 5) Make all forms have proper spacing on mobile (min 44px touch targets). 6) Fix navigation menu - ensure it covers full screen on mobile with proper z-index. 7) Ensure all grid layouts collapse properly (single column on mobile). 8) Fix cart page mobile layout - product images, quantity controls. 9) Fix checkout steps to be vertical on mobile instead of horizontal. 10) Ensure floating Telegram button doesn't overlap important content on mobile. Test with viewport 375px width.

COMPLETE TRANSLATIONS: Ensure ALL text on the website uses the i18n t() function. 1) Go through EVERY component and replace ANY hardcoded Ukrainian/English text with t('key') calls. 2) Add missing translation keys to uk.json, en.json, es.json. 3) Translate the ADMIN PANEL fully - all labels, buttons, messages in all 3 languages. 4) Translate ALL toast messages, error messages, success messages. 5) Translate 404 page messages. 6) Translate footer text completely. 7) Translate all form placeholders. 8) Ensure product names and descriptions support translation. 9) Add language-specific number and currency formatting. 10) Make sure Spanish translations are accurate (not machine translated garbage). Important: The admin panel should also be fully translated and usable in all 3 languages.

CRITICAL FIXES - Part 1: Blog & Footer & SKU/Weight: 1) Fix blog.tsx - make all article cards fully clickable with proper Link wrapper, add individual blog post page /blog/:slug that shows full article content with proper layout. 2) Update Footer.tsx - add payment icons section at bottom: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay SVG logos with text 'Ми приймаємо' / 'We accept'. Also add HACCP certification badge and quality certificate mention. 3) Update database schema to add: sku (string, unique product code like 'BT-PU-1L-001'), weight_grams (integer for logistics), dimensions (string like '10x10x25cm'), barcode (string). 4) Update admin products CMS to show/edit SKU, weight, dimensions fields. 5) Add legal pages: /privacy (Privacy Policy), /terms (Terms of Service), /return-policy (Return Policy) - with proper Ukrainian legal text templates for e-commerce. Include HACCP certification mention, quality guarantees, return within 14 days per Ukrainian law.

CRITICAL FIXES - Part 2: Complete i18n Translation: Go through EVERY page and component and ensure ALL text is translated using t() function. Check and fix: 1) index.tsx (homepage) - ALL sections: HowItWorks titles/descriptions, UsageScenarios titles/descriptions, Testimonials. 2) products.tsx - filter labels, empty state. 3) product-detail.tsx - all labels, brewing guide steps. 4) b2b.tsx - ALL text including calculator labels, benefits, case studies. 5) adaptation.tsx - ALL 6 steps content, FAQ questions/answers, resources. 6) blog.tsx and blog-post.tsx - category names, read time, dates should be localized. 7) contacts.tsx - all contact info labels. 8) checkout.tsx - all step labels, form fields, delivery options. 9) account.tsx - all tabs, labels, stats. 10) admin.tsx - sidebar labels, table headers. 11) accessories.tsx - all filter labels, category names. Add missing translations to uk.json, en.json, es.json for: howItWorks section, usageScenarios section, testimonials section, b2b page full content, adaptation page full content, checkout delivery options, admin panel labels. Every single visible text MUST use t() function.

ФІНАЛЬНІ ВИПРАВЛЕННЯ 1: 1) Fix blog posts - make them clickable by wrapping entire blog post card in Link to /blog/:slug. Create individual blog post pages with full article content. 2) Add Visa/Mastercard icons to Footer - download SVG icons and place them with 'Ми приймаємо:' text in payment methods section. 3) Add product SKU (артикул) and weight fields to database schema and product forms: sku (string), weight_kg (decimal), dimensions (string). Display in admin and on product pages. Update Nova Poshta integration to use weight for shipping calculations. 4) Add HACCP and quality certificates section to homepage and /about page: show certificate badges, add trust section with 'Сертифіковано HACCP', 'ISO 22000', 'Лабораторно протестовано'. Create placeholder certificate images or use icons.

CRITICAL FIXES - Part 3: SEO Audit & Certificates Section: 1) Create a prominent 'Trust & Quality' section on homepage (before footer) showing: HACCP certification logo/badge, ISO 22000 mention, 'Сертифікована продукція' label, '100% натуральний склад' label, 'Made in Ukraine 🇺🇦' label. 2) Add to product detail pages: certification badges section below product info. 3) Update SEO component with enhanced meta for e-commerce: add 'product' schema with gtin/sku, add aggregate rating schema placeholder, add 'offers' with availability status. 4) Ensure every product page has unique canonical URL. 5) Add breadcrumb structured data to all category pages. 6) Create /certificates page showing all quality certifications with downloadable PDF placeholders. 7) Update robots.txt to ensure proper crawling of product pages. 8) Add hreflang tags for uk/en/es versions of each page.

FINAL FIXES 2: 1) Create /privacy-policy and /terms-of-use pages (required by law) in Ukrainian/English/Spanish with proper legal text: data protection (GDPR-like), cookie policy, return policy (14 days by Ukrainian law), warranty, dispute resolution. 2) Add links to these pages in footer. 3) Double-check ALL pages are fully translated - go through: index.tsx (hero, stats, how it works, scenarios, testimonials), products.tsx (all filter labels), product-detail.tsx (effects, brewing, reviews section), adaptation.tsx (all 6 steps), account.tsx (all 7 tabs), admin.tsx (all sections). Fix any remaining hardcoded Ukrainian text. 4) Add admin panel direct links section to documentation.

FINAL QA FIXES: 1) Verify blog articles are clickable - ensure blog-post.tsx page exists and works with proper routing /blog/:slug. If missing, create it with: article header, full content area, author info, related articles, back to blog link. 2) Fix any remaining hardcoded Ukrainian text in: b2b.tsx (profit calculator labels, case studies, benefits), adaptation.tsx (all 6 steps, FAQ, resources), contacts.tsx (working hours, contact methods labels). 3) Ensure Footer has visible Visa/Mastercard/payment icons - if not showing, add them with proper SVG icons and 'Ми приймаємо:' text above. 4) Add Google Maps embed placeholder or OpenStreetMap iframe in contacts page showing Lviv location. 5) Verify mobile menu shows language switcher and theme toggle. 6) Test that checkout flow works end-to-end with proper translations at each step.
